note: Milestone 70: section completion -- each filing's { checks, incomplete } map and its progress -- for every fixture and variant tests/unit/completion-parity.spec.js builds, all nine filing identities. Recorded in 70L from the frozen copy of legacy-app.js's computeNavChecks() and getWardProgress() as they stood before 70D moved them (which that spec had evaluated beside the new evaluators, and found equal on every one); `results` holds each distinct outcome once, `types` each variant's label and outcome. Regenerate only for a deliberate, recorded change: PG_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 npx vitest run tests/unit/completion-parity.spec.js, and say why here. Changed by Milestone 71B (2026-09-29, attorney optional when none is entered): the Annual family's a-p5 and the Simplified s-p5 are complete with no attorney started (s-cover and s-p6 likewise stop requiring one), a-p10 requires the certifying guardian when co-guardians and no attorney, and the Minor Plan's pm-p7 follows validatePlanMinor(): each of preparer and attorney optional until started, then name plus a valid signature (the saturated variants, whose signature fields hold the literal Yes, now read incomplete there, as the validator reads them). New variants cover the fields 71B added. Changed by Milestone 71C (2026-09-29, a share is a percentage from 0 to 100): the D-1 to D-5 marks and Part VIII (a-p8) also need every share in range or blank, as validateAnnual() now says; the variants whose trust row is filled with the literal Yes (every saturated variant, and the two 'trusts one full row' ones) read Part VIII incomplete for that reason. Changed by Milestone 72B (2026-10-02, the attorney's emails on every form; a blank Inventory share reported): new variants only, for the email keys the models gained; no existing outcome changed. Among them, clearing the Inventory attorney's primary email in a valid filing leaves D-2 incomplete, as validateGuardian() now says; the browser suite's Inventory overlay (tests/e2e/support/fixtures.ts) names its attorney's email. Changed by Milestone 72C (2026-10-02, a guardian's email is a warning on every form; one 'attorney started' test per Plan; the attorney's name required once started): clearing the Simplified guardian's email leaves Part IV (s-p4) complete, as validateSimplified() no longer asks for it; clearing the attorney's name in an Annual, Final or Trust Accounting with an attorney leaves Part V (a-p5) incomplete, as validateAnnual() now requires it; on the Annual Plan and the Plan for Minors any one attorney field on its own starts an attorney, so the signature page (pa-p11, pm-p7) is incomplete until the attorney's name, email and signature are complete, and reads as begun rather than untouched; the Plan for Minors' attorney needs an email (a name alone used to complete pm-p7). New variants cover the Inventory's and Initial Plan's guardian email and the Simplified Plan's certSignerMigrated marker; none changes an outcome. Changed by Milestone 72H (2026-10-02, the certificate's attorney is the filing's): clearing the attorney's name, Florida Bar number, phone or address typed on D-5 no longer leaves D-5 incomplete -- D-5 no longer asks for them, D-2 does. New variants cover certAttorneyMigrated on the Inventory and the Simplified; none changes an outcome. Changed by Milestone 72G (2026-10-02, the method of service and the ward's status kept apart): clearing the Simplified's method (certIndicator) no longer leaves Part VI (s-p6) incomplete -- a missing method warns and never blocks; the ward's status (certWardStatus) is required on Part VI and on the Annual family's Part X (a-p10), and the browser suite's Annual and Simplified overlays (tests/e2e/support/fixtures.ts) answer it. New variants cover certWardStatus, certIndicatorMigrated and the Inventory's serviceMethod; no other outcome changed. Changed by Milestone 73A (2026-10-06, a guardian signs by hand or by stamp; each year's data carries signaturePolicy, 2 on every new filing): a guardian's signature counts on the Annual family's Part III (a-p3), the Simplified's Part IV (s-p4), the Annual Plan's signature page (pa-p11), the Initial Plan's (pi-p9) and the Plan for Minors' (pm-p6) only when the export check accepts it -- the saturated filings' unreadable choice, which every validator already refused, leaves those pages incomplete where a typed date used to complete them (on the Annual family a second guardian's too); a guardian's blank choice is Unsigned and complete without a date, so the Annual Plan's and the Simplified Plan's first guardian with only a name, or with the date cleared, no longer leaves pa-p11 or ps-p3 incomplete. New variants clear signaturePolicy (the legacy rule); each returns what its sibling does.
